en: Colorized photograph of a steamship passing through a large canal lock cut into rocky terrain. High stone lock walls rise on both sides, with gates visible at each end of the lock chamber. The surroundings are heavily forested with coniferous trees on rocky hills. On the right bank stands a small red-and-white control building, and several people are seen walking along the lock edge. In the distance, more lock gates and calm canal water extend toward a wooded landscape under a lightly clouded sky.
